1|#include "zutil.h"      /* for Z_U4, Z_U8, z_crc_t, and FAR definitions */
2|
3| /*
4|  A CRC of a message is computed on N braids of words in the message, where
5|  each word consists of W bytes (4 or 8). If N is 3, for example, then three
6|  running sparse CRCs are calculated respectively on each braid, at these
7|  indices in the array of words: 0, 3, 6, ..., 1, 4, 7, ..., and 2, 5, 8, ...
8|  This is done starting at a word boundary, and continues until as many blocks
9|  of N * W bytes as are available have been processed. The results are combined
10|  into a single CRC at the end. For this code, N must be in the range 1..6 and
11|  W must be 4 or 8. The upper limit on N can be increased if desired by adding
12|  more #if blocks, extending the patterns apparent in the code. In addition,
13|  crc32.h would need to be regenerated, if the maximum N value is increased.
14|
15|  N and W are chosen empirically by benchmarking the execution time on a given
16|  processor. The choices for N and W below were based on testing on Intel Kaby
17|  Lake i7, AMD Ryzen 7, ARM Cortex-A57, Sparc64-VII, PowerPC POWER9, and MIPS64
18|  Octeon II processors. The Intel, AMD, and ARM processors were all fastest
19|  with N=5, W=8. The Sparc, PowerPC, and MIPS64 were all fastest at N=5, W=4.
20|  They were all tested with either gcc or clang, all using the -O3 optimization
21|  level. Your mileage may vary.
22| */
23|/* Define N */
24|#ifdef Z_TESTN
25|#  define N Z_TESTN
26|#  define N 5
27|#endif
28|#if N < 1 || N > 6
29|#  error N must be in 1..6
30|#endif
31|/*
32|  z_crc_t must be at least 32 bits. z_word_t must be at least as long as
33|  z_crc_t. It is assumed here that z_word_t is either 32 bits or 64 bits, and
34|  that bytes are eight bits.
35| */
36|/*
37|  Define W and the associated z_word_t type. If W is not defined, then a
38|  braided calculation is not used, and the associated tables and code are not
39|  compiled.
40| */
41|#ifdef Z_TESTW
42|#  if Z_TESTW-1 != -1
43|#    define W Z_TESTW
44|#  endif
45|#else
46|#  ifdef MAKECRCH
47|#    define W 8         /* required for MAKECRCH */
48|#  else
49|#    if defined(__x86_64__) || defined(__aarch64__)
50|#      define W 8
51|#    else
52|#      define W 4
53|#    endif
54|#  endif
55|#endif
56|#ifdef W
57|#  if W == 8 && defined(Z_U8)
58|     typedef Z_U8 z_word_t;
59|#  elif defined(Z_U4)
60|#    undef W
61|#    define W 4
62|     typedef Z_U4 z_word_t;
63|#  else
64|#    undef W
65|#  endif
66|#endif
